notes.title: 《Stellar Blade》PC - 1.4.0 Patch notes
notes.content: [p]🔸As a token of appreciation for all the love and support from our players, we've prepared 6 newly arranged tracks based on existing BGM.[/p][p]Visit 'The Last Gulp' in Xion to receive 'A Thank You Gift From Enya'[/p][p]-The Song of the Sirens (Arrange)[/p][p]-Star Descent (Arrange)[/p][p]-Arisa (Arrange)[/p][p]-Democrawler (Arrange)[/p][p]-Everglow (Arrange)[/p][p]-Hypertube (Arrange)[/p][p]🔸Players with the Complete Edition can now claim an exclusive CD-KEY for 『胜利女神: 新的希望』[/p][p]Players who have already redeemed a  CD-KEY on another server can still claim an additional CD-KEY for this server.[/p][p]🔸Fixed an issue where, on PC, using a controller with 'Swap Confirm/Cancel Buttons' enabled would cause the UI to display incorrectly after completing a quest.[/p][p]🔸Fixed an issue during the 'Oblivion' side-quest where the flooded water would disappear before reaching the sewage control device step, preventing progression.[/p][p]🔸Fixed an issue in Orbital Elevator - 'CARGO LIFT 121' where resting during elevator dialogue could occasionally cause the dialogue to restart or the elevator to freeze.[/p][p]🔸Fixed an issue in Boss Challenge where Scarlet would disappear during a phase transition cutscene if Tachy Mode was activated.[/p][p]🔸Improved key input handling so that Left/Right variants (L/R) of modifier keys (Ctrl, Alt, Shift, Cmd) are now recognized as the same input.[/p][p]🔸Fixed an issue in the NIKKE collaboration mini-game where using 'Burst Skill △' on specific monsters would make them immune to Eve’s ranged attacks, preventing progress.[/p][p]🔸Fixed an issue where dodging became unavailable if the player attempted to dodge while shooting after using 'Burst Skill X' in the NIKKE mini-game.[/p][p]🔸Fixed an issue where the reeling icon appeared gray after switching the fishing method from 'Reel In Controls' to 'Timing Controls' input.[/p][p]🔸Fixed an issue where a black box would appear on screen when playing on a Samsung Odyssey 3D monitor.[/p][p][/p][p]🔸Various other bug fixes[/p]

notes.title: 《Stellar Blade》PC - 1.3.2 Patch notes
notes.content: [p]🔶 Stellar Blade will be playable in 3D via the Samsung Odyssey 3D Hub ([url="https://www.samsung.com/us/support/computing/monitors/gaming/odyssey-3d-gaming-monitor/"]official site[/url]) update on August 29th at 08:00 PDT.[/p][p][/p][p]\[Requirements][/p][p]- A Samsung Odyssey 3D Display is required.[/p][p]- The game must be initialized through Samsung Odyssey 3D Hub.[/p][p]- For other matters, please refer to the manufacturer's official website for support and recommended hardware.[/p]

notes.title: 《Stellar Blade》PC - 1.3.1 Patch notes
notes.content: [p]🔸Fixed an issue where the FSR and DLSS Frame Generation features were disabled due to incorrect detection of the 'Hardware-accelerated GPU scheduling' setting on certain systems.[/p][p][/p][p]For Windows 10 users, please follow these steps to enable 'Hardware-accelerated GPU scheduling':[/p][p]1. Type 'Graphics Settings' in the Windows search bar and open the \[Graphics Settings] menu.[/p][p]2. In the Graphics Settings menu, enable \[Hardware-accelerated GPU scheduling].[/p][p]3. Restart your PC to apply the changes.[/p][p][/p][p]🔸Fixed an issue where the 'FSR 3 Frame Generation' feature could not be enabled on certain UMPC devices.[/p]

notes.title: 《Stellar Blade》PC - 1.3.0 Patch notes
notes.content: [p]🔸Improved Photo Mode so that when selecting a logo, the logo control indicator is now displayed.[/p][p]🔸Fixed an issue where players were unable to exit the shop after purchasing the 'Polarized Sunglasses' from Clyde’s shop.[/p][p]🔸Fixed an issue where Eve’s hair would not appear during the final Elder Naytiba cutscene when wearing the 'Fluffy Bear' or 'Pink Bear' outfits.[/p][p]🔸Fixed an issue where Eve's final Korean voice-over line was cut off during the 'Lost Items from Heaven' conversation with Clyde in the Great Desert.[/p][p]🔸Fixed an issue where Eve’s arm would occasionally appear unnatural in Photo Mode when wearing the 'Black Pearl' or 'Red Pearl' outfits.[/p][p]🔸When using FSR upscaler, restarting the game is now required to enable frame generation.[/p][p]🔸Fixed an issue where the Fusion Weapon was not visible when beginning the fight against the Airborne Squad after defeating Providence.[/p][p]🔸Fixed an issue where using the numpad on the keyboard to trigger skills in the Training Room caused the training system to become unresponsive.[/p][p]🔸Fixed an issue where, when fishing for the 'Betta' fish with mouse and keyboard, the gray striped pattern of the progress bar would obscure the reel-in progress bar.[/p][p]🔸Fixed an issue where, when using the 'Stinger', target lock-on would not function correctly under specific input conditions.[/p][p]🔸Fixed an issue where the zoom function in the Hair Salon menu would not respond to controller or keyboard input.[/p][p]🔸Fixed an issue where dialogue would occasionally not display after interacting with Adam in the Eidos 9 Atelier.[/p][p]🔸Fixed an issue where Dororong would occasionally not appear during their introduction scene in Xion.[/p][p]🔸Fixed an issue where newly unlocked items would not immediately appear after increasing shop affinity level.[/p][p]🔸Improved the save timestamp system so that time since last save is now accurately displayed based on successful saves, rather than attempted saves.[/p][p]🔸Enhanced the save failure message by changing it to yellow for better visibility.[/p][p][/p][p]🔸Various other bug fixes.[/p]

notes.title: 《Stellar Blade》PC - 1.2.0 Patch notes
notes.content: [p]🔸 Along with the 1.2.0 patch, Stellar Blade items are coming to the Steam Points Shop![/p][p]- Badges, Trading Cards, Still and Animated Backgrounds, Stickers, and more![/p][p][/p][p]🔸As a token of appreciation for all the love and support from our players, we've prepared 7 newly arranged tracks based on existing BGM.[/p][p]Visit "The Last Gulp" in Xion to receive "A Thank You Gift From Enya"[/p][p]- Don’t Forget Me (Trio)[/p][p]- Flooded Commercial Sector (Trio)[/p][p]- Clock Tower (Trio)[/p][p]- White Night (Trio)[/p][p]- Wasteland – Reboot (Trio)[/p][p]- Oasis (Trio)[/p][p]- Don’t Forget Me (Refresh)[/p][p]🔸"Hard Mode" is now available from the start of the game. "Hard Mode" is also unlocked for Boss Challenge.[/p][p]🔸If saving fails during gameplay, a save failure message will be displayed at the center-left of the screen.[/p][p]🔸A save file recovery feature has been added. If a save becomes corrupted, a backup save can now be restored upon launching the game.[/p][p]🔸In the graphics options menu, the Expected VRAM display has been improved to display both current usage and expected maximum usage.[/p][p]🔸Fixed an issue during the quest "Where Is The Fantastic Bait?" where the bait dropped from underwater boxes was occasionally unobtainable.[/p][p]🔸Fixed an issue where the logo rotation key did not work in Photo Mode when using an AZERTY keyboard.[/p][p]🔸Fixed an issue where EVE’s gun would occasionally disappear on some PCs after using a Burst Skill in the NIKKE mini-game.[/p][p]🔸Fixed an issue where, upon entering the "Demogorgon" battle, the camera would sometimes move away from the intended position, making aiming impossible.[/p][p]🔸Fixed an issue where the artbook would occasionally not appear on the title screen after completing the first playthrough.[/p][p]🔸Players who obtained the "Planet Diving Suit (2nd)" by connecting their PlayStation Network account can now purchase the "Design Pattern: Planet Diving Suit (2nd) V2" at Roxanne’s shop during New Game +.[/p][p]🔸Fixed an issue where entering Boss Challenge while wearing "Planet Diving Suit (6th) V3" would cause the outfit to revert to the "Skin Suit".[/p][p]🔸Fixed an issue during the Scarlet battle where QTEs could cause abnormal character motion and camera behavior.[/p][p]🔸Fixed an issue where the game would occasionally crash when entering Photo Mode.[/p][p][/p][p]🔸 Various other bug fixes.[/p]

notes.title: Both Stellar Blade and Dune: Awakening shot into Steam's top 100 with new concurrent player peaks yesterday
notes.content: The sexiest game out there broke a new concurrent player record over the weekend. That's right—Dune: Awakening broached the top 100 most-played games of all time on Steam, netting a peak concurrent player count of 189,333 players online on Sunday. That puts it at a happy 85 on SteamDB's chart of most-played games, sandwiched between Football Manager 2020 (84) and the Enhanced Edition of GTA 5 (86)... Read more.

notes.title: Stellar Blade review
notes.content: Stellar Blade's opening hours are so mired by atrocious level design that I can only assume people are willingly ploughing through for the sake of seeing protagonist Eve's bum jiggle around in a skin-tight suit for a bit longer... Read more.

notes.title: Stellar Blade's director throws down the gauntlet at modders, whose 'firepower is still weak'—all the sexy costumes are cool, he just also wants mods that 'expand the user’s play experience'
notes.content: Stellar Blade is out on PC, and you know what that means—Mods, Mods as far as the eye can see. Sometimes (41% of the time, to be exact) salacious mods, if history, and indeed our present day is any indication... Read more.

notes.title: Gooner game of the year Stellar Blade's mods are 41% smut, ensuring gamers will never see the light of heaven
notes.content: Stellar Blade finally hit PC two days ago, giving everyone a chance to do whatever it is this game is actually about. Unfortunately, no one knows what that is, because the entirety of discourse surrounding it is about the main character's butt... Read more.

notes.title: Stellar Blade is doing better numbers than almost every other PlayStation port on Steam, and it's probably not just because of the nude mods
notes.content: It's great that so many PlayStation games have come to PC in the last few years, letting me stack a heap of extra big-budget videogame junk food on my pile of shame. Welcome to the backlog, Horizon Zero Dawn. These games haven't always set the Steam top sellers list on fire, however, sometimes thanks to a marketing budget you'd have to squint to see. How many people even knew Marvel's Spider-Man 2 came out on PC at the end of January? No wonder it only managed a peak player count of 28,189... Read more.

notes.title: 《Stellar Blade》PC Official Release Notes!
notes.content:
🔸 Supports high-resolution textures
🔸 Supports AI upscaling (NVIDIA DLSS 4, AMD FSR3) and Frame Generation
🔸 Frame rate limit disabled
🔸 Ultra-wide display support (5:4 to 32:9)
🔸 Key mapping functionality added for keyboard, mouse, and controller

🔸 Boss Challenge: Mann has been added
- Available after the first playthrough; Defeat Mann to acquire one new outfit for EVE.

🔸 The Digital Artbook is available after completing the first playthrough
🔸 New cosmetics can be acquired during gameplay
- 25 new outfits for EVE
- 9 new accessories for EVE

🔸 Lip-sync for the following two voiceover languages is now available in all regions:
- Chinese, Japanese

🔸 Three new BGM tracks, “Lullaby of Secret”, “Just Fine”, and “Blur”, have been added to the turntable and are available for listening at the camp

🔸Various other bug fixes.

notes.title: The Stellar Blade PC system requirements are here and even an entry-level graphics card from 2016 can run it
notes.content: The Stellar Blade PC system requirements are refreshingly light, meaning even a cheap rig from almost a decade ago can run Sony's NieR 'em up. With the onslaught of Unreal Engine 5 (Stellar Blade uses UE4) games launching, we can't expect every game to be as light, but my hopes are up that more Sony ports follow this trend... Read more.
